fused_conclusion: The current exact-source blocker should not be answered by making fs-verity mandatory. F2 already owns artifact identity through FRANKENSTEIN2_RELEASE_MANIFEST/v1 and F2-WP-1207 release/readback lineage. The missing evidence discriminator is manifest-to-consumed-byte binding. Add a small ReleaseConsumptionWitness at the Python loader/import boundary, hashing and consuming the same acquired bytes without path reopen. Treat fs-verity as optional defense in depth only when the admitted target already supports it without privilege/deployment distortion.

minimal_runtime_algorithm: anchor release root and resolve only manifest-listed canonical paths
SHA-256 that buffer and match manifest path+size+digest
compile/execute/import that same buffer without reopening the pathname
append canonical witness entry bound to release manifest, active release, run and process identity
fail closed on mismatch, substitution, path escape, missing manifest membership or acquisition drift
optional_hardening: fs-verity digest/content verification when already supported and authenticated
sealed memfd only when verified bytes must cross a process boundary

trigger4_next_ablation.precondition: Do not seek promotion credit until the owner-provisioned target VPS workspace is clean and exact-source/current under the active supervisor hygiene fence.
tests: CURRENT_LOADER_ABLATION: determine whether existing F2 import/runtime path already hashes and consumes the same manifest-verified bytes; if yes, add receipt instrumentation only
ATOMIC_PATH_SWAP: after acquisition or prehash, replace pathname with different valid Python bytes; witness must either consume the original verified bytes or reject
DIGEST_MISMATCH: manifest expected digest differs from acquired bytes; fail closed before compile/exec
UNMANIFESTED_IMPORT: release-local code outside manifest must not receive exact-source consumption credit
PATH_ESCAPE_OR_SYMLINK: constrained release acquisition must reject noncanonical escape/substitution
ACTIVE_RELEASE_MISMATCH: consumption witness must not bind to a release different from WP1207 readback
OPTIONAL_FS_VERITY_ABLATION: absence of fs-verity must not fail the baseline; when present, record it as an additional integrity signal rather than runtime proof
trigger4_next_ablation.promotion_rule: Only Trigger4 may promote through F2 ablation/build/target-runtime acceptance. E3 local reproduction grants zero target-runtime, physical-target or whole-system credit.

falsifiers: If current F2 loader already consumes exactly the same manifest-verified byte buffer with no pathname reopen/substitution opportunity, reduce this delta to receipt instrumentation.

If measured target overhead or import incompatibility from a custom same-byte loader is material, prefer build-time packaging into a single immutable/importable artifact and witness that artifact rather than per-module interception.

If target-host fs-verity is already universally enabled, authenticated and operationally free, it may be adopted as an additional integrity layer, but it still does not replace process-consumption binding.
